exchangeability_note: ratio far from 1.0 means the audit split is a harder or easier problem, so promotion checks need a level shift, not a raw comparison

composite_calibration.definition: composite = mean(ndcg@10, recall@50) per user; the quantity the competition scores as mean over m of delta(m)
composite_calibration.paired_SE_source: EASE l=500 click-only vs EASE l=500 content_alpha=0.05, search_val, B=4000 user bootstrap
composite_calibration.rationale: 2.8 * paired SE ~= 0.00199, rounded to 0.002. Model-INDEPENDENT: sigma_seed is a property of the model (exactly 0 for EASE, .00113 for BPR-MF) whereas sigma_eval is a property of the evaluation set. Using BPR-MF's seed MDE (0.00338) as the floor rejected a real EASE improvement of +0.00328.
